text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, Mr. Breakout~. When are you ever 
gonna clear up~?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty much at my limit with keeping 
secrets from Trainer-chan, though~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Hmm. What should I do about this...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...You've seemed super busy lately, so I 
really didn't wanna make you worry even 
more~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Totes gotta do whatever skincare I can. 
Did I still have leftovers from the one I 
bought before~?
